plans.title: The deck: a tmux command center for agent sessions
plans.summary: Adds `sb deck`, a tmux session holding one window per agent, plus a queue of sessions waiting on the operator, read by both surfaces. It is the first surface built to act, and the long-term goal is that it fuses with the canvas.

plans.title: The deck as a tab in the canvas
plans.summary: Embeds the whole running deck in the canvas as a nav tab, a second tmux client that follows the terminal's size. It is the first step of fusing the two surfaces.

plans.title: Grid observability
plans.summary: What sky.boss misses about skeletor's agentic grid: off jobs drawn as if they fire, no agent-hours rollup, no stagger view, no category grouping. Each gap has a ruling.

plans.title: Highlight — lexical tint for followed lines
plans.summary: Tints a followed line by shape rather than by severity, and lets the operator declare their own vocabulary without repainting sky.boss's. Round 8 is open — the sample that makes such a declaration writable against what a log actually contains.
